tool_args.rationale: The pilot observations and mechanism note support a coupled memory ODE, but the five paid rows are insufficient to identify its four parameters reliably. Acquire the specified additional trajectory batch before fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The supplied coupled-memory mechanism requires at least eight rows to fit its four parameters; the trajectory batch directly addresses that shortfall.
Five rows leave insufficient identification margin for the four-parameter coupled model.
These uncoupled alternatives do not account for the observed history gap and coupled transient lag.
